messages.subject: lavaan 0.6-14 has been released
parts:
Dear all,

lavaan 0.6-14 has been released on 9 Feb 20223. This is is mostly a
bug-fixing release. If you are using 0.6-13, please upgrade.

For more information, see: https://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot6.html

Yves.
